Bend your lamp's beam with shared mirrors and hold the reef's crystals alone. 2 to 4 players.

This is a league-based game: new rules unlock as you climb.

Night falls on the Tidereef. Its crystals drink lamplight and keep it until dawn. You keep a lamp on the reef's edge and a bag of 12 mirrors. Bend your beam onto the crystals: each turn, every crystal your light touches pays you.

Goal

Score more points than the other lamp keepers by lighting crystals with your lamp's beam.

The reef

The reef is a square grid of N x N cells (N is odd, 13 to 19). x is the column (0 on the left), y is the row (0 at the top); north is towards y = 0. 2 to 4 players play. Each player owns a lamp on one edge. The reef looks the same from every lamp (90-degree rotational symmetry). With 2 players the lamps are on opposite edges; with 3 players one edge has no lamp.

Cells:

  • . empty: a beam goes through;
  • 1 2 3 a crystal and its value: a beam goes through and lights the crystal;
  • A B C D the lamp of player 0, 1, 2, 3: a beam that reaches it stops;
  • There are no rocks.
  • Every crystal is worth 1.

Beams

After all actions of a turn, every lamp fires one beam. It leaves the lamp in the lamp's direction and moves cell by cell until it leaves the reef, reaches a rock or reaches a lamp. Beams never block each other and a beam cannot loop. A beam that crosses the same crystal twice lights it once. Your lamp's straight line holds no crystal, rock or mirror at the start: to score, you must bend your beam.

Mirrors

A mirror turns a beam by 90 degrees:

MirrorBeam moving eastnorthwestsouth
type 0 = /leaves northleaves eastleaves southleaves west
type 1 = \leaves southleaves westleaves northleaves east

Mirrors belong to nobody: a mirror bends every beam that reaches it, yours and your opponents'. Players cannot remove mirrors. Mirrors stay until the end.

Actions

Each turn you print one action:

  • PLACE x y type: put one of your mirrors on an empty cell. You have 12 mirrors for the whole game.
  • WAIT: do nothing.

You may add a message after your action, for example PLACE 5 3 1 hello (30 characters max).

Yards. Each lamp's yard is the 5 x 3 block of cells around it (the lamp cell, and every cell up to 2 cells away along the edge and up to 2 cells deep, diagonals included). Only the yard's owner may place mirrors there. Beams cross yards freely.

Same cell. If two or more players place a mirror on the same cell in the same turn, all of them fail and keep their mirror.

Impossible actions are replaced by WAIT (the reason is shown in the game summary): a cell outside the reef, a type other than 0 or 1, a cell that is not empty (rock, crystal, lamp, mirror), a cell in another player's yard, no mirror in hand. A line that is not a valid command (keyword and whole numbers) eliminates you.

Scoring

Each turn, every player whose beam lights a crystal gains its value. Several beams on one crystal all score it.

Order of a turn

  • All placements.
  • Every lamp fires.
  • Scoring.

End of the game

The game ends after 100 turns, or when fewer than two players remain. The highest score wins; equal scores share the rank. A player who does not answer in time or prints an invalid line is eliminated: score -1, its lamp becomes a rock, its yard stays protected.

Example (an example reef, not a real map)

N = 13. Your lamp is at (0,3) and fires east; a crystal of value 1 is at (5,6). You print PLACE 5 3 1. Your beam goes (1,3) ... (5,3), turns south on \, crosses (5,4), (5,5), lights (5,6) and goes on south. You gain 1 every turn.

Game input

Initialization

  • Line 1: playerCount myId
  • Line 2: N
  • Next playerCount lines: playerId lampX lampY dir (dir is E, S, W or N)
  • Next N lines: one row of the reef, N characters, y = 0 first
  • Next line: crystalCount
  • Next crystalCount lines: x y value phase (phase is -1: always awake)

Each turn

  • Line 1: turn (starts at 1)
  • Next playerCount lines, by player id: score mirrorsInHand active (active 1, or 0 if eliminated)
  • Next line: mirrorCount
  • Next mirrorCount lines: x y type lock pending life (every listed mirror, pending or active, fills its cell: you cannot place there)
    • type: 0 (/) or 1 (\)
    • lock: 0 when it can be turned (always 0 in this league)
    • pending: 1 if not yet bending beams, else 0 (always 0 in this league)
    • life: active turns left before it shatters (always -1 in this league: mirrors never wear)
  • Next line: crystalCount
  • Next crystalCount lines: x y awake litBy s_0 ... s_(playerCount-1)
    • awake: 1 or 0 (always 1 in this league)
    • litBy: the player who lit it alone on the last turn, -1 nobody (and on turn 1), -2 several players
    • s_i: player i's streak on it, 0 to 4 (always 0 in this league)

Output: one line with one action, optionally followed by a message: PLACE x y type or WAIT.

Tokens are separated by spaces; any other separator (a tab, for example) makes the line invalid.

Constraints: 2 <= playerCount <= 4; 13 <= N <= 19, odd; response time 1000 ms on turn 1, 50 ms after. Rows and lists are sorted by y, then x.

Each player owns a lamp on one edge. The reef looks the same from every lamp (90-degree rotational symmetry). With 2 players the lamps are on opposite edges; with 3 players one edge has no lamp.

  • # rock: a beam stops.

After all actions of a turn, every lamp fires one beam. It leaves the lamp in the lamp's direction and moves cell by cell until it leaves the reef, reaches a rock or reaches a lamp. A mirror turns a beam by 90 degrees:

type 0 = /leaves northleaves eastleaves southleaves west
